I actually support this. Repealing and replacing 17 was on my list for a while, and it would've been my next major thing after repealing 10 had I stuck around. Now, with [GA 747 "Responsible Usage of World Assembly Funds"](https://www.nationstates.net/page=WA_past_resolution/id=747/council=1) existing, it's never been a better time to finally move past 17, and 747 means a replacement wouldn't even be that helpful

747 does everything that 17 does, and it's way better written: it handles how funds are spent, what happens if there isn't enough funding, how to ensure transparency, and even has a proactive funding mechanism that doesn't force authors to waste characters saying "my proposal uses the general fund" and getting their resolution repealed because of how it handles funding (see [495](https://www.nationstates.net/page=WA_past_resolution/id=495/council=1)). I've been wanting someone to do proactive funding *forever* and Ice finally did it!

So that leaves 17 as an obsolete resolution that... bans deficit spending *for the WA* (not just the general fund; what a weird pseudo-blocker), has a weird half-assed reporting requirement, and has that dishonest "mandatory donations" requirement that doesn't provide a superadded benefit beyond "there shall be money" (which you kinda have to assume anyway for the WA to make any sense) and IMO actively hobbles things by being clumsily written. It's like spelling out a clumsy requirement in a normal resolution instead of having a committee do it. The way you spell out your requirement should be beneficial

Repealing 17 won't suddenly make the WA not have any money - partly because that's as silly as saying that the first [438](https://www.nationstates.net/page=WA_past_resolution/id=440/council=1) resolutions were just impotent suggestions and partly because 747 - and the repeal's decently written. This feels more like cleanup than an earth-shattering change

It's also a bit personal for me in the same way 10 was because... I don't think there should be these mythical resolutions that can never be touched because then the sky falls, especially when there's redundancy and they aren't even particularly good
I’m not sure we will be seeing a replacement go through any time soon though lol

That's what I'm saying- thanks to 747, a replacement isn't really needed. I think that given 747, 17 does more harm than good now. Like repealing GA10 without replacement after IA's resolution came along. Of course it would be preferable to have a solidly written replacement, but repealing this thing was always going to be an uphill fight and it's never been a better time to do it
